name: ReviewSummary
description:
A product-reviews card: the average score with stars and a review count, the breakdown by stars and a social-proof footer - composed from Rating, Meter, Separator and AvatarGroup.

  ReviewSummary(rating: 4.8, reviews: 1_284) do
    ReviewBreakdown(counts: product.reviews.group(:stars).count)
    ReviewHighlight(avatars: recent_reviewers) { "Loved by 12,000+ shoppers" }
  end

Localized (review_summary.locales.yml): the review count is pluralized and every number uses the current locale's format.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `ReviewSummary(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

ReviewBreakdown.description: The share of reviews per star, highest first, as meters. `counts:` maps stars to review counts (e.g. `reviews.group(:stars).count`); pass `href:` (a proc of the star) to link each row to the filtered reviews.

ReviewHighlight.description:
The social-proof footer under a separator: a few reviewer avatars and a line of text.

  ReviewHighlight(avatars: [ { src: "/avatars/02.png", alt: "Liam Hudson" } ]) { "Loved by 12,000+ shoppers" }

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: The Appica homepage card. The stars show the exact average (4.8 fills four and four-fifths).
examples.code:
phlex do
  ReviewSummary(max:, verified:, **given(label:), rating: rating.to_f, reviews: COUNTS.values.sum, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    ReviewBreakdown(counts: COUNTS)
    ReviewHighlight(avatars: REVIEWERS) { "Loved by 12,000+ shoppers" }
  end
end

examples.name: Linked rows
examples.notes: With `href:` each row links to the reviews filtered by that star.
examples.code:
phlex do
  ReviewSummary(rating: 4.8, reviews: COUNTS.values.sum, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    ReviewBreakdown(counts: COUNTS, href: ->(stars) { "#reviews-#{stars}-stars" })
  end
end

examples.name: Few reviews
examples.notes: The count is pluralized per language ("1 verified review", "3 ověřené recenze").

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says: stars and meters fill from the right.
examples.code:
phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      ReviewSummary(rating: 4.8, reviews: COUNTS.values.sum, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
        ReviewBreakdown(counts: COUNTS)
        ReviewHighlight(avatars: REVIEWERS) { "أحبه أكثر من 12,000 متسوق" }
      end
    end
  end
end
